pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown patches with highly irregular, serrated edges exhibiting sharp pixel gradients. Geometry is complex-polygonal with frequent deep, narrow indentations into the patch bodies.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light tan inter-patch pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent. Pixel thickness varies, significantly narrowing at points where patch 'teeth' converge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents as a dark, low-profile ridge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations corresponding to hair follicle clusters against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized regions of textural disruption and light-colored crusting are visible on the upper shoulder and mid-dorsal ridge, characterized by a loss of typical pelage smoothness.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct vertical indentation or notch is visible in the mane at the lower neck region. Visible textural irregularities suggesting skin thickening are present on the upper flank.
